note: First match wins. `detail` = FIWARE subCategoryDetailed, `sub_category` = subCategory, `text_any` = any of these words in description. kind null = ignored (counted in `skipped`). An unknown type is never ignored silently: it falls to `default` (penalty). Quirk (seen 23/10): programmed alerts (RoadAlerts) carry day-level validFrom/validTo, and the real hours are in the description ('Das 08:00 às 14:00 de 24/10'); with hours_in_description, BarrierTools parses them.
